head_coach.name: Sébastien Desabre
head_coach.play_style_summary: Pragmatic and highly structured. Desabre focuses on defensive solidity using a compact mid-block, high physical work rate, and rapid direct attacking transitions exploiting the pace of wide forwards and mobile full-backs.

key_players.name: Noah Sadiki
key_players.performance_stats: An energetic, tactically disciplined central midfielder who made 33 appearances for Sunderland in the 2025/26 season, anchoring the midfield with strong tackle-winning ability and excellent positional discipline.

key_players.name: Yoane Wissa
key_players.performance_stats: A versatile, pacy, and direct forward who made 19 appearances for Newcastle United in the 2025/26 season, offering high work rate and explosive transition play after recovering from knee injuries.

key_players.name: Simon Banza
key_players.performance_stats: A physically imposing striker who scored 19 goals in 31 league matches during a prolific 2024/25 loan spell at Trabzonspor, finishing as the Turkish Süper Lig's second-highest goalscorer.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Withdrawn from the World Cup squad due to a suspected Achilles injury sustained on the final day of the Scottish Premiership season with Hibernian.
